theme_cn: 高频词汇 + 完形填空 + 听力

vocab.example_en: The payment went through in a second.
vocab.hint_cn: 买东西把钱给出去这一步

vocab.example_en: He took a photo of his card and put it in his wallet.
vocab.example_cn: 他给卡拍了照，然后放进钱包。

vocab.example_en: Please scan this code before you pay.
vocab.example_cn: 付款前请扫一下这个码。

vocab.example_en: Most students now read digital books on a tablet.
vocab.example_cn: 现在大多数学生在平板上读电子书。
vocab.hint_cn: 跟电脑、网络有关的那种

vocab.example_en: Paying by phone is convenient for busy people.
vocab.example_cn: 用手机付款对忙碌的人来说很方便。

cloze.passage: Last Saturday I went to the community library as a 1___. The librarian, Ms Chen, showed me around and gave me a simple job. My work was to put the returned books back in the right 2___, and at first I made a few mistakes, but she told me to read the 3___ on each cover carefully. By noon I had finished two shelves. A little girl asked me for a story about 4___, so I found one with lovely pictures of pandas. In the afternoon we read aloud to 5___ children who came with their parents. When I left, Ms Chen smiled and said I had done a good 6___.
sentences_cn: 上周六我去社区图书馆当志愿者。
图书管理员陈老师带我参观了一圈，还给我派了一件简单的活儿。
我的工作是把还回来的书按正确顺序放回去；一开始我出了几个错，但她让我仔细看书上的标签。
到中午我已经整理完两个书架。
一个小女孩向我要一本关于动物的故事书，我给她找了一本有可爱熊猫图片的。
下午我们给跟着爸爸妈妈来的更小的孩子朗读。
我离开时，陈老师笑着说，我干得很棒。

questions.explanation_cn: 去社区图书馆帮忙做事的人是志愿者 volunteer。visitor 只表示参观者。
put the books back in the right order 按正确顺序放回书，与后文看标签对应。
封面上贴的标签 label 写着编号，用来判断该放哪。
下文说 pictures of pandas（熊猫图片），所以是动物的故事。
跟父母一起来的、需要别人读故事的孩子，是更小的孩子 younger children。
do a good job 干得好，是固定搭配。

listening.question: 听到的句子是什么？
listening.audio_text: The high-speed train runs at 350 kilometres an hour.
options: The high-speed train runs at 350 kilometres an hour.
The high-speed train runs at 150 kilometres an hour.
The high-speed train runs at 350 kilometres a day.
The high-speed bus runs at 350 kilometres an hour.
listening.explanation_cn: 数字 350（三百五十），单位 an hour（每小时）。

listening.question: 听到的句子是什么？
listening.audio_text: You can scan the QR code with your phone.
options: You can scan the QR code with your phone.
You can scan the QR code with your card.
You can send the QR code with your phone.
You can scan the bar code with your phone.
listening.explanation_cn: 动词 scan（扫描）+ QR code（二维码）+ with your phone（用手机）。

listening.question: 听到的句子是什么？
listening.audio_text: Grandpa has used the payment app for two years.
options: Grandpa has used the payment app for two years.
Grandpa has used the payment app for two months.
Grandpa used the payment app two years ago.
Grandma has used the payment app for two years.
listening.explanation_cn: has used 现在完成时 + for two years 持续两年。

listening.question: 听到的句子是什么？
listening.audio_text: The astronauts fix their sleeping bags to the wall.
options: The astronauts fix their sleeping bags to the wall.
The astronauts fix their sleeping bags to the floor.
The astronauts put their sleeping bags on the wall.
The astronauts fix their water bags to the wall.
listening.explanation_cn: sleeping bags（睡袋）固定在墙上（to the wall），因为在太空会飘。

listening.question: 听到的句子是什么？
listening.audio_text: Each solar term comes about fifteen days apart.
options: Each solar term comes about fifteen days apart.
Each solar term comes about fifty days apart.
Each solar term comes about fifteen weeks apart.
Each season comes about fifteen days apart.
listening.explanation_cn: fifteen days（十五天）和 apart（相隔）都是关键词。
